comment: Canonical ATS answers for the apply loop. Edit policy here, never mid-form. Per-ATS aliases map one intent to each vendor's exact option label.

identity.locationCombobox: New York City, New York, United States

salary.policy: If the posting shows a range, answer at or just under its top. If no range, anchor at $220,000. Phrase: '$<amount>, flexible depending on equity and total package.'

aliases: I do not want to answer

neverDo: Invent street address, SSN, or any government ID
Claim work authorization for countries other than the US
Fabricate employment history or credentials (e.g., buyside experience)
parkAndMoveOn: Cross-origin embedded iframes that swallow input (Databricks pattern)
Forms requiring street address + ZIP (ask Alex)

ashby: Upload resume FIRST via the autofill input, then wait 3-4s: the form re-renders and refs go stale.
After autofill, re-check Phone and LinkedIn — autofill re-render clears manually-entered values (Sierra ADP failure).
Comboboxes: click, type query, wait 1s, click the highlighted option. Never trust form_input alone.
Watch for stray keystrokes leaking into focused comboboxes (the 'New YorkAshby' failure). End+BackSpace xN to repair.
'We're updating your forms' warning after submit = wait 5s, find Submit again, click again.
Verify success via page text 'Success', not the button state.
greenhouse: form_input works for text fields. Country phone-prefix select is required whenever Phone has a value even if unstarred — set it or submit silently fails (Webflow/Unframe failure).
Location (City) is a Google-Places combobox: click, type 'New York', click 'New York, NY, USA'.
Selects are custom dropdowns: click the control, then click the option row.
Demographics section is optional — skip entirely rather than answering.
Success = redirect to /confirmation with 'Thank you for applying.'
lever: Plain HTML form; standard fill. 404 on /apply means the posting is gone.
phenom: Resume parser can hang the page 60-120s (Mastercard/Qualtrics). Upload a .txt resume variant or park it.
